scenario.name: Hurricane Delphine (simulated)
scenario.description: A fictional Category 3 hurricane making landfall near Galveston, Texas. Posts were written for this demo; photos are public-domain images from past real storms.

region.name: Greater Houston and the upper Texas coast

posts.text: Hurricane Delphine now a Cat 3, landfall expected near Galveston tonight. Finish your prep now #Delphine #hounews
Lines out the door at the grocery store in Pearland, water and bread almost gone #Delphine
Mandatory evacuation for Galveston Island in effect. Traffic on I-45 northbound barely moving #Delphine
Anyone know a good pizza place still open in Katy? asking for a friend lol #hurricaneparty
Wind picking up fast in Galveston, waves already over the seawall #Delphine
Praying for everyone on the coast tonight. Stay safe Texas ❤️ #Delphine
Power just went out across our whole street in League City. Transformer blew, saw the flash #Delphine
Shelter open at the convention center downtown Houston, bring ID and medications if you can #Delphine
Roof of the gas station on 61st St in Galveston just peeled off. Debris everywhere #Delphine
Water coming into the house in Dickinson, already ankle deep and rising. We have kids and a dog, need a boat #DelphineRescue
Watching the radar, this thing is huge. Rain bands all the way to Beaumont #Delphine
Elderly neighbor in Friendswood can't get out, water to her porch steps, she uses a wheelchair. Please help #DelphineRescue
Brays Bayou is out of its banks near Meyerland. Streets underwater #Delphine #houstonflood
I-610 underpass at Kirby completely flooded, a car is stuck with the driver on the roof #Delphine
Can't sleep, storm sounds like a freight train. Anyone else up? #Delphine
Coast Guard helicopters overhead in Port Arthur, people waving from rooftops #Delphine
Family of 5 trapped in attic on Bellfort Ave, water still rising. Please send help #DelphineRescue
Our church in Pasadena is opening as a shelter. We have cots, food and dry clothes. Come as you are #Delphine
Tree fell on the house next door in Kingwood, part of the roof is gone, family got out ok #Delphine
Highway 225 closed both directions near Deer Park due to high water #Delphine
Bridge on FM 518 in Pearland washed out. Do NOT try to cross #Delphine
My dad has been missing since last night, last seen near Clear Lake. Grey truck. Please share #Delphine
Boat volunteers launching from the Kroger lot on Fuqua, we need more boats and life jackets #CajunNavy #Delphine
National Guard high water trucks moving people out of Meyerland #Delphine
Can someone check on the apartments on Westpark? Ground floor units underwater and people on the balconies #DelphineRescue
Rainfall totals already over 20 inches in parts of Harris County, more coming tonight #Delphine
Dropping off water and diapers at the Sugar Land donation center, they need baby formula most #Delphine
Saw on TV the stadium might open as an overflow shelter. Anyone confirm? #Delphine
Whole neighborhood in Baytown flooded, cars floating down the street #Delphine
Two people with injuries at the corner of Main and Holcombe waiting for an ambulance, roads blocked #Delphine
So proud of my city. Strangers rescuing strangers all night #HoustonStrong #Delphine
Hospital in Beaumont lost water pressure, transferring patients #Delphine
Aerial view of Port Arthur this morning. It looks like a lake #Delphine
Who's watching the game later? need something normal today #Delphine
Volunteers needed at the shelter in Katy to sort clothes and serve meals, shifts every 4 hours #Delphine
Levee near Columbia Lakes is being overtopped, residents told to leave now #Delphine
Storm surge pushed boats onto the highway in Kemah #Delphine
My mom's nursing home in Dickinson has water inside, residents still there. Please someone help #DelphineRescue
Gas stations in Sugar Land out of fuel, long lines at the ones that have it #Delphine
Rain finally slowing down in Houston. Bayous expected to crest later today #Delphine
Collapsed wall at the strip mall on Telephone Rd. Stay away from damaged buildings #Delphine
Found: small brown dog near Braeswood, no collar. Keeping him safe until we find his family #Delphine
Free hot meals at the food truck on Washington Ave from noon until supplies last #Delphine
Our street in Meyerland after the water went down. Everything we owned is on the curb #Delphine
Mold already starting in the walls. Anyone know how to get FEMA assistance? #Delphine
Still stuck on second floor in Port Arthur with 3 neighbors, no food since yesterday. Water won't go down #DelphineRescue
Coffee and a dry pair of socks never felt so good. Thank you to the volunteers at the Pasadena shelter #Delphine
Downed lines across Spencer Hwy, live wires in the water. Stay out #Delphine
School district says all campuses closed through Friday #Delphine
Crews working to reopen I-10 east of Baytown, still closed at the river #Delphine
Blood drive tomorrow at the community center in League City, donors needed #Delphine
Roofs gone on the whole block in Freeport, houses split open #Delphine
Cleanup crew of 20 heading to Kingwood Saturday morning. Bring gloves and boots #Delphine
Can't believe how fast the water came up. Still processing all of it #Delphine
Man injured by debris while clearing his driveway in Friendswood, neighbors applying pressure, EMS on the way #Delphine
Sinkhole opened on the frontage road near Beltway 8 and Bissonnet #Delphine
Donations of cleaning supplies needed in Dickinson: bleach, masks, trash bags #Delphine
Best sunset tonight, first clear sky in days #Delphine
Elderly couple in Baytown hasn't been heard from in two days, last known on Bayway Dr. Can someone check? #DelphineRescue
Power restored to about half of Galveston Island according to the utility #Delphine
FEMA disaster recovery center opening Monday in Pasadena #Delphine
Our school gym in Pearland became a supply hub, hundreds of volunteers today. This city 💪 #Delphine
